title: Say who you work for
quote: You must never represent yourself as a {{client}} employee. You work for {{employer}}. You are calling on behalf of {{client}}.

title: Give the recording disclosure
quote: Give it in the first 30 seconds, every call.

title: Book only. No advice, quotes or comparisons
quote: You are not a financial adviser. Never give product recommendations, quote premiums, or suggest what level of cover a prospect needs. Your role ends at booking the appointment with a {{client}} adviser.

title: Never book a specific time
quote: Never book a specific time. The broker reaches out to organise it.

title: Wrap a completed lead as Lead Submitted
quote: Lead Submitted: The only code to use when a completed lead has been submitted to {{clientShort}}.

title: Use the approved line about their details
quote: "Fair question. {{clientShort}} provided your details as part of their outreach programme." Use this line only. Never guess where the details came from.
section: Section 2.3, "Where Did You Get My Details?"

title: If they push, offer to pass it to the client's team
quote: If they continue to push or become irate: Offer to pass their details to {{clientShort}} so the team can follow up on where their information originated.
section: Section 2.3, "Where Did You Get My Details?"

title: Do not go back to the booking
quote: Don't go back to the booking. End the call politely.
section: Section 09, Angry about their number or privacy

title: Accept a do not call request without argument
quote: If someone asks not to be called again, accept it without argument and wrap the call as DNC.

title: Wrap a do not call request as DNC
quote: If a customer says "don't call me again" and you fail to disposition as DNC, that customer will be called again. This is a compliance breach.
